summary: IN and BETWEEN are shorter ways to write common filters.
points: genre IN ('Fiction', 'Science') means the value equals any item in the list.
price BETWEEN 10 AND 20 includes both 10 and 20.
NOT IN and NOT BETWEEN reverse them.
BETWEEN also works on text dates, because they sort correctly in YYYY-MM-DD form.

example.explanation: This finds everyone hired during 2021, including anyone hired on the first or last day.
